rebalance_callable_by_any_address.meaning: rebalanceFunds() can be invoked by any address with no access restriction

repeated_calls_unlimited.meaning: no mechanism limits repeated rebalanceFunds() calls

any_address_trigger.meaning: any address can trigger vault rebalancing via rebalanceFunds()

custodian_event_flooded.meaning: TopUpRequestedFromCustodian and ExcessFundsTransferredToCustodian events are flooded by spam rebalanceFunds() calls, creating a denial-of-service against custodian infrastructure

assumptions: rebalanceFunds() emits TopUpRequestedFromCustodian and ExcessFundsTransferredToCustodian events as stated in the impact.
The custodian's off-chain infrastructure processes these events and is the DoS target.

unresolved.description: Report does not give a numeric call-rate or event-count threshold defining when spam becomes a denial-of-service; the flood condition is represented as a grounded Boolean.

limitations: The flood/DoS condition is qualitative; no numeric rate limit or event-count bound is stated, so it is bound as a Boolean observable for later code binding.
Only the event_flood_dos impact is formalized here; unauthorized rebalance completion and custodian monitoring disruption are handled in separate passes.
